pages.title: Celestial Ritual
pages.text: A Celestial Ritual uses the $(l:hexalia:core_mechanics/natures_ritual#structure)shared Ritual Table setup$(/l) but draws energy from nearby Celestial Blooms instead of crops. It begins at night.

pages.title: Requirements
pages.text: Keep the recipe’s required number of living $(l:hexalia:resources/herbs#celestial_bloom)Celestial Blooms$(/l) near the Table at its height. Fresh and Withered Blooms can supply energy; the recipe pages show how many are needed.

pages.title: Process
pages.text: At night, use a Hex Focus on the prepared Table. The selected offerings and their salt are spent during the offering stage; the participating Braziers remain. If you cancel afterward, the offerings are not returned.

pages.title: Transformation
pages.text: On success, the catalyst becomes the output and each selected Bloom loses one stage: Fresh becomes Withered, and Withered becomes a Dead Bush. Cancelling before success does not degrade the Blooms.

pages.title: On Use
pages.text: Each recipe shows its own Bloom requirement. Galeberries and Celestial Crystals begin this path; Moonweave upgrades use the same ritual with their own requirements.
